item.title: What if the real risk of AI isn’t deepfakes — but daily whispers?
item.description: Most people don’t appreciate the profound threat that AI will soon pose to human agency. A common refrain is that “AI is just a tool,” and like any tool, its benefits and dangers depend on how people use it. This is old-school thinking. item.title: When AI lies: The rise of alignment faking in autonomous systems
item.description: AI is evolving beyond a helpful tool to an autonomous agent, creating new risks for cybersecurity systems.
